import math

def compute_lcm(a, b):
    return a * b // math.gcd(a, b)

best_diff = 1e9
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

if y <= n:
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    while g > 1:
        x //= g
        y //= g
        g = math.gcd(x, y)
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        h = compute_lcm(i, y)
        w = x * (h // y)
        diff1 = abs(w - ((w // (h // i)) * (h // i))) / h
        if best_diff > diff1:
            best_diff = diff1
            best_num = w // (h // i)
            best_den = i
        numerator = w + (h // i) - 1
        denominator = h // i
        diff2 = abs(w - ((numerator // denominator) * denominator)) / h
        if best_diff > diff2:
            best_diff = diff2
            best_num = numerator // denominator
            best_den = i
    g = math.gcd(best_num, best_den)
    best_num //= g
    best_den //= g
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
